frigate.notes: ABUS Performance Line is Hikvision OEM — Hikvision-style RTSP paths (101 main / 102 sub / 103 third). Enable ONVIF/RTSP in the camera web UI (Network > Integration Protocol) first. Pattern from the IPCx OEM family (iSpyConnect, HA community); not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration after enabling ONVIF (Profile S) in the web UI.
